title: 1984 AHSME Problem 22
statement: Let \(a\) and \(c\) be fixed positive numbers. For each real number \(t\) let \((x_t,y_t)\) be the vertex of the parabola \(y=ax^2+tx+c.\) If the set of vertices \((x_t,y_t)\) for all real values of \(t\) is graphed in the plane, the graph is

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text: part, but not all, of a parabola

solutions.text:
The vertex coordinates are \[ x_t=-\frac{t}{2a},\qquad y_t=c-\frac{t^2}{4a}. \] Since \(t=-2ax_t,\) eliminating \(t\) gives \(y_t=c-ax_t^2.\) As \(t\) ranges over all reals, so does \(x_t,\) so the entire parabola is traced.

Therefore, the correct answer is B.
hints: Write the vertex coordinates in terms of \(t\)
